decisions.reason: The tracked minor edits and removal of full stops from table text do not change the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker from the book title.
The client-supplied tracked edits and punctuation change necessarily alter the text that the copyedited manuscript must preserve.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I have now completed my review, Nadia. Here is my feedback:

1\. Page1 contains only an image and no text. Is that intentional for the cover? Will the printed cover have no text, and how will it be presented?
2\. Page 2 contains only the title, subtitle, and author name, with no image. Is that the intended layout?
3\. The publication line says Published in India by Cedar Nest Family Circle. Can this be changed later?
4\. The images for the chapters listed below appear elongated. If you provide the required dimensions, I can regenerate them at the correct size so they do not look distorted.
\- Chapter6
\- Chapter11
\- Managing the In-Laws
\- For the Partner
5\. In Chapter15, the upper-right portion of the image is cut off. Once I have the proper dimensions, I can send a replacement for that image as well.
6\. I removed the full stops from the table text.
7\. Chapter18 has a different punctuation and capitalization treatment in its first line: every word begins with a capital letter. In the previous revision, that first line was formatted like a subtitle, while the following lines began on a new line as normally punctuated body text. Because both lines are now on the same level, the first line looks inconsistent.
8\. I made some minor text edits, which are available through Track changes.
9\. Could you advise what front matter and back matter content is required, and whether anything else is needed before publishing?

value_updates.client_tracked_text_edits: Incorporate the minor text edits supplied through Track Changes in the reviewed file

decisions.reason: The manuscript text edits and table punctuation change do not alter the independently stated image aspect-ratio or cropping requirements.
The source change does not revise or remove the publication attribution line; the separate question about whether it can be changed later establishes no new attribution value.

The selected source modification concerns tracked text edits and table punctuation, while the Chapter 18 typography requirement is independently established by another clause and already has its own same-message history.
The tracked manuscript edits and removal of table-text full stops do not resolve or change the cover-design ambiguity.
The source modification does not change the permitted image source, suitability-review obligation, or image suitability criteria.
The source modification does not change chapter-image inclusion, coverage, identification, or placement.
